description: Fork of exp090 with widened model dims: E=144 (was 96), d_v=24 (was 16), n_heads*d_v=144=E preserved. d_qk=32 unchanged. Unembedder simplified to LN(E) -> Linear(E, VOCAB) (no MLP hidden layer). All other settings unchanged: per-chunk partition_sets for residual_lut (within-chunk pairs only, no chunk weights), residual_tph_per_layer_factor=256, anchor inheritance from layer (i-1), inverse concat residual order, per-block LayerNorm, single optimizer (adam_lr=0.0003 wd=0.1).
